pages.title: MARVINS MAGIC ZipString Blister Vivacious Violet - Violet
pages.description: ZipString is a mesmerizing toy that floats a seemingly standard loop of string in the air. It carefully balances several forces of gravity, lift, tension, and drag to fly the string in the air. Any movement that a Zipster (a user of a ZipString) does, the string follows.
